dedupe_keys.name: abwise agent based wildfire simulation environment fire front as mobile agents responding to vegetation wind and terrain

description: ABWiSE, the Agent-Based Wildfire Simulation Environment, represents a moving fire front as a set of mobile fire agents that respond to and interact with vegetation, wind and terrain. The CoMSES Net release read on 2026-09-28 (version 1.0.0, published 20 December 2021 by Jeff Ledge and Liliana Perez) states that its current purpose is exploratory: to show how an agent-based model, with simple interactions between agents and a simple atmospheric feedback model, can reproduce emergent fire spread patterns. It is written in NetLogo 6.1.1. Coverage is generic landscapes, not a named region. Access is free download under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: it is a research prototype, not an operational fire behaviour model, and it is not validated against observed fires in the summary. It supports hazard exposure studies at an exploratory level, such as testing how wind shifts drive a fire front toward a power line corridor or settlement edge. No related agent-based wildfire spread model is catalogued.
